summary.text: Eleanor Chávez, listed by Ballotpedia as Eleanor Chavez, is a Democratic state representative from New Mexico House District 26 who took office on January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Chávez's career experience includes working as a community organizer.

paragraphs.text: Chávez earned a B.A. from the University of Washington in 1976 and a master of social work from the University of Washington in 1978.
Chávez served as director of the National Union of Hospital and Health Care Employees, District 1199, from 1997 to 2008.
In the 2025-2026 session, Chávez serves on the Health & Human Services Committee and is vice chair of the Labor, Veterans' and Military Affairs Committee.
